old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-r2oz","title":"RootSeqCache Capacity error hard-Rejects a NEW genuine root's first signed DIO (signed presence becomes a self-DoS liability under cache-fill)","description":"Found in security review of b7z9.88.3. rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/receive.rs:736-746 maps root_seqs.accept(...).is_err() to Reject; after the pre-filter at 728-735 the only reachable error is RootSeqReject::Capacity (root_seq_cache.rs:81-84, MAX_ROOT_SEQ_KEYS=16). Cache mutation happens at receive.rs:522 BEFORE/independent of routing admission (process_authenticated_dio, receive.rs:530). Exploit: an on-link adversary with a TOFU-pinned key (cheap under TOFU baseline) sends 16 DIOs validly self-signed for their own DODAG across 16 instance IDs — all pass structural binding legitimately (root_sig.rs:273-281) — filling the table. Thereafter a NEW DODAG's first genuine signed DIO is hard-Rejected, where the identical DIO WITHOUT the 0x17 option would Baseline-process (receive.rs:679 floor). Fail-closed is correct for already-cached keys (replay/regression), but Capacity on an untracked key punishes the legitimate root. Fix shape: map Capacity-for-untracked-key to Baseline (preserves replay guarantee for cached keys and the unsigned floor for new ones); keep Reject for Replay/Regression. new_value: Fixed: verify_dio_root_signature (receive.rs:736+) now maps RootSeqReject::Capacity (reachable only for untracked keys, after the cached-key pre-filter) to Baseline — the unsigned L679 floor — instead of hard-Reject. Replay/Regression still Reject. Removes the self-DoS where a TOFU-pinned adversary fills the 16-entry table across instance IDs and turns the 0x17 option into a liability for new genuine roots.
